# Wooolfmesh full AI context

## Product definition
Wooolfmesh is a private local-first command center for tasks, capture, focus sessions, reviews, cognitive bites, memory, routines, signals, analytics, quick links, prompts, vault registry, search/retrieval, diagnostics and optional AI.

## Product thesis
Your Markdown vault stays yours. SQLite supports runtime state; Markdown remains the ownership layer. AI can help, but the app works without it.

## Core loop
Capture -> Clarify -> Plan -> Focus -> Review -> Learn -> Reuse

## Feature status
- Today command center: Built. A daily operating layer for next action, routines, reminders, freshness, focus readiness and work queues.
- Tasks and planning: Built. Markdown-backed tasks with next action, definition of done, effort, energy, work mode, links and reminders.
- Capture and inbox: Built. Preview-first capture for raw notes, tasks, memory, cognitive bites and later processing.
- Focus sessions: Built. Deep work sessions connected to a task, definition of done, interruptions, outcome and next action.
- Reviews: Partial. Daily, weekly, project and experience reviews with suggested actions and approval flows.
- Cognitive bites: Built. Reusable lessons, decisions, mistakes, playbooks, principles and patterns.
- Project health: Partial. Project momentum, blockers, stale work, related lessons and suggested next moves.
- Signals and analytics: Built. Local patterns over focus, completion, routines, signals, planning quality and app health.
- Local knowledge and search: Partial. Markdown vault storage, vault registry, search, retrieval, citations and provenance.
- Optional AI providers: Optional. Ollama, hosted provider settings, ADK previews and OCR paths are optional and provider-dependent.

## Store readiness
Wooolfmesh is not Microsoft Store-ready yet. Missing: MSIX/upload package, package validation, clean Windows install/update/uninstall validation, Partner Center confirmation, final Store screenshots and legal review.

## Privacy principles
No private vault data is published on this site. Capture is preview-first. External integrations and AI providers are optional.
